style: Gritty comic-book style card illustration for a dark-fantasy deckbuilder. Heavy, slightly rough black ink outlines with ink hatching in the shadows; cel shading with two or three tones per colour; a subtle grunge paper texture over everything; saturated but slightly muted colours. One clear subject shown close-up, usually entering from the lower-left edge and moving diagonally toward the upper right, partly cropped by the frame. Background: a flat colour field crossed by sharp, jagged, diagonal brush-streak shapes in a darker tone. White curved motion arcs around anything that moves; a burst of debris, sparks or glowing particles at the point of impact. Readable at thumbnail size. No text, no letters, no numbers, no card frame, no border, no watermark, no UI.
style_refs_note: The attached images are style references from the same card set. Match their drawing style exactly: line weight, ink hatching, cel shading, paper texture, background streaks, motion arcs and level of detail. Do not copy their subjects or composition unless asked.
